name.description: The field name or path for data access.

label.description: Column label for display. If not set, {@link #name} is used.

valueType.description: The identified value type of the column.

rowLabel.description:
If true, this column is not part of the data proper, but represents the row labels generated by the grid.

@see DataGrid#labelCol

rowIndex.description: If this is a #rowLabel, whether it is displaying the index of the row instead of some other key.

flattened.description:
Whether this column is the expansion of a collection in the source object. In this case, the #valueType will be
that of the collection element type and the values displayed will be elements of the collection. In the case of
maps, two columns will be produced, one for the key and one for the element.

@see DataGrid.Flattened

align.description: Override the default alignment. If not specified, numeric columns are right-aligned and others are left-aligned.

title: Meta information about each column in a {@link DataGrid}.
name: DataGrid.Col
